questions.question:
What is the mode of the following data?

55, 45, 44, 48, 42, 45, 52, 53, 42, 50, 54, 49, 52, 45, 47, 43, 45, 48
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mode is the observation that appears the maximum number of times in a data set.

By simply observing the given numbers, we can see that 45 repeats the most.

Frequency of 45 = 4 times.

Frequencies of 42, 48, and 52 are 2 times each, while others appear only once.

**∴ The correct answer is 45.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data set: 55, 45, 44, 48, 42, 45, 52, 53, 42, 50, 54, 49, 52, 45, 47, 43, 45, 48

**Formula Used:**

Mode = Value with the highest frequency in a given set of data.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let us arrange the given data in ascending order:

⇒ 42, 42, 43, 44, 45, 45, 45, 45, 47, 48, 48, 49, 50, 52, 52, 53, 54, 55

⇒ Counting the frequencies of the numbers:

⇒ Frequency of 42 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 45 = 4

⇒ Frequency of 48 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 52 = 2

⇒ Frequencies of 43, 44, 47, 49, 50, 53, 54, 55 = 1 each

⇒ Since 45 occurs the most (4 times), the mode of the given data is 45.

**∴ The correct answer is 45.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean

The mean is the average of all numbers in a dataset. It is calculated as Mean = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations).

Median

The median is the middle value when the data set is arranged in ascending or descending order. If the number of observations is even, it is the average of the two middle numbers.

Mode

The mode is the value that appears most frequently in a dataset. A dataset can have one mode (unimodal), more than one mode (multimodal), or no mode if all values have the same frequency.

Empirical Relationship

For moderately skewed distributions, the relationship between mean, median, and mode is given by: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.

questions.question: A person covers half the distance of a journey at 60 km/h and the other half at 30 km/h. What is the average speed for the entire journey?3217
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When two equal distances are covered at speeds x and y, the average speed can be found directly using the formula:

Average Speed = (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y)

⇒ Average Speed = (2 × 60 × 30) ÷ (60 + 30)

⇒ Average Speed = 3600 ÷ 90

⇒ Average Speed = 40

**∴ The correct answer is 40 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed for the first half of the distance = 60 km/h

Speed for the second half of the distance = 30 km/h

 Total Distance = 2d
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 

 
• 
 
 
 
 
 

 Distance = d
 Speed = 60 km/h

 

 Distance = d
 Speed = 30 km/h

 Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

Let the total distance of the journey be 2d.

⇒ Distance of each half segment = d

⇒ Time taken for the first half (t₁) = d ÷ 60

⇒ Time taken for the second half (t₂) = d ÷ 30

⇒ Total Time taken (T) = t₁ + t₂ = (d ÷ 60) + (d ÷ 30)

⇒ T = (d + 2d) ÷ 60 = 3d ÷ 60

⇒ T = d ÷ 20

⇒ Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

⇒ Average Speed = 2d ÷ (d ÷ 20)

⇒ Average Speed = 2d × (20 ÷ d)

⇒ Average Speed = 40

**∴ The correct answer is 40 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed (Unequal Distances)

When different distances d₁, d₂, d₃ are covered at speeds v₁, v₂, v₃ respectively, Average Speed = (d₁ + d₂ + d₃) ÷ (t₁ + t₂ + t₃).

Average Speed (Three Equal Distances)

If a person covers three equal distances at speeds x, y, and z, the overall Average Speed = 3xyz ÷ (xy + yz + zx).

Relative Speed

When two objects move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (S₁ + S₂). When moving in the same direction, it is the difference (S₁ − S₂).
</p

questions.question: Find the value of sec² 50^circ - tan² 50^circ .
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

According to the standard trigonometric identity: sec² θ − tan² θ = 1

Here, the angle θ is directly given as 50°.

Substituting θ = 50° into the identity directly gives 1.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The trigonometric expression: sec² 50° − tan² 50°

**Formula Used:**

For any angle θ where the functions are defined, the basic relationship between secant and tangent is:

sec² θ − tan² θ = 1

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let θ = 50°

⇒ sec² 50° − tan² 50° = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

**__Additional Information__**

Basic Pythagorean Identities

sin² θ + cos² θ = 1
1 + tan² θ = sec² θ
1 + cot² θ = cosec² θ

Reciprocal Identities

sin θ = 1 ÷ cosec θ | cos θ = 1 ÷ sec θ | tan θ = 1 ÷ cot θ

Complementary Angle Formulas

sin(90° − θ) = cos θ | sec(90° − θ) = cosec θ | tan(90° − θ) = cot θ
</p

questions.question:
A retailer offers the given discount schemes for buyers on an article. Which of the following schemes will be least beneficial to the customer?

i. A discount of 34%

ii. A discount of 37% followed by a discount of 8%

iii. Successive discounts of 7% and 27%

options.text: Both scheme ii and scheme iii

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use net price factors instead of calculating discounts separately.

i: 34% ⇒ Pay = 66%

ii: 37% then 8% ⇒ 0.63 × 0.92 = 0.5796 ⇒ Discount = 42.04%

iii: 7% then 27% ⇒ 0.93 × 0.73 = 0.6789 ⇒ Discount = 32.11%

**∴ Answer = Scheme iii (least discount)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Three discount schemes

**Formula used:**

Successive Discount = a + b − (a × b)/100

**Calculation:**

⇒ i: Discount = 34%

⇒ ii: 37 + 8 − (37 × 8)/100 = 45 − 2.96 = 42.04%

⇒ iii: 7 + 27 − (7 × 27)/100 = 34 − 1.89 = 32.11%

⇒ Least discount = 32.11%

**∴ The correct answer is Scheme iii.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

Net Discount = a + b − (a × b)/100

Equivalent Single Discount

Convert multiple discounts into one using above formula

Price Multiplier Method

Final Price = MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100)

Customer Benefit Rule

Higher discount ⇒ More benefit, Lower discount ⇒ Least benefit

questions.question: A person saves 50% of his income. If his expenditure is ₹360, then his income (in ₹) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If savings is 50% of the income, the remaining 50% must be the expenditure.

Since both savings and expenditure are exactly 50% each, Income is directly double the expenditure.

Total Income = Expenditure × 2 = 360 × 2 = 720

**∴ The correct answer is ₹720.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Savings = 50% of Income

Expenditure = ₹360

**Formula Used:**

Total Income = Expenditure + Savings

 
 
 
 Expenditure: 50%
 Savings: 50%
 
 ₹ 360
 ?
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Total Income: 100%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total income of the person be x.

⇒ The person saves 50% of x, so Savings = 0.5x

⇒ Expenditure = Total Income − Savings

⇒ 360 = x − 0.5x

⇒ 0.5x = 360

⇒ x = 360 ÷ 0.5

⇒ x = 720

**∴ The correct answer is ₹720.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income, Expenditure & Savings Concept

Income is always equal to the sum of Expenditure and Savings. When calculating percentages, the base Total Income is always taken as 100%.

Successive Percentage Framework

If someone spends x% on one category and y% of the *remaining* on another, Final Savings = Income × (100 − x)/100 × (100 − y)/100.

Ratio & Multiplier Method

If an income-to-savings ratio is given, assume the initial values as multiples of 100 (e.g., 100a) to conveniently evaluate any subsequent percentage changes without encountering decimals.

questions.question: Solve: (9.73 times 9.73 times 9.73 + 7.27 times 7.27 times 7.27)/(9.73 times 9.73 - 9.73 times 7.27 + 7.27 times 7.27)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Recognize identity: a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²)

Here denominator = a² − ab + b²

So expression = (a³ + b³) ÷ (a² − ab + b²) = a + b

a = 9.73, b = 7.27 ⇒ sum = 17

**∴ Answer = 17**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(9.73 × 9.73 × 9.73 + 7.27 × 7.27 × 7.27) ÷ (9.73 × 9.73 − 9.73 × 7.27 + 7.27 × 7.27)

**Concept Used:**

Algebraic identity

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let a = 9.73 and b = 7.27

⇒ Numerator = a³ + b³

⇒ Denominator = a² − ab + b²

⇒ Using identity: (a³ + b³) = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²)

⇒ So expression = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) ÷ (a² − ab + b²)

⇒ Cancel common term ⇒ a + b

⇒ = 9.73 + 7.27 = 17

**∴ The correct answer is 17.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Identity: a³ + b³

a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²)

Identity: a³ − b³

a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²)

Simplification Trick

Always check numerator and denominator for identity patterns before expanding

Common Exam Pattern

Expressions of form (a³ + b³)/(a² − ab + b²) simplify directly to (a + b)

questions.question: Find the greatest number that divides 1005, 244 and 1343, leaving the remainders 5, 4 and 3, respectively.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required number divides (Number − Remainder)

So take: 1005−5=1000, 244−4=240, 1343−3=1340

Find HCF of 1000, 240, 1340

HCF = 20

**∴ Answer = 20**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers: 1005, 244, 1343 with remainders 5, 4, 3

**Formula used:**

Required number = HCF of (Number − Remainder)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 1005 − 5 = 1000

⇒ 244 − 4 = 240

⇒ 1343 − 3 = 1340

⇒ HCF(1000, 240) = 40

⇒ HCF(40, 1340) = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Remainder Concept

If a number leaves remainder r, then (Number − r) is exactly divisible

HCF (GCD)

Greatest number dividing all given values exactly

Euclidean Method

HCF(a, b) = HCF(b, remainder)

Exam Shortcut

Always subtract remainders first, then find HCF

questions.question: A basket contains 96 fruits consisting of mangoes and oranges. If there are 48 more mangoes than oranges, how many mangoes are there?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the sum and difference of two quantities are given, you can find the larger quantity directly:

Larger Quantity = (Sum + Difference) ÷ 2

Number of Mangoes = (96 + 48) ÷ 2

Number of Mangoes = 144 ÷ 2 = 72

**∴ The correct answer is 72 mangoes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total number of fruits in the basket = 96

Difference between mangoes and oranges = 48

 Total Fruits = 96
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
 Oranges (x)

 
 Mangoes (x + 48)

 x + (x + 48) = 96

**Calculation:**

Let the number of oranges be x.

Then, the number of mangoes will be x + 48.

⇒ Total fruits = Mangoes + Oranges

⇒ 96 = (x + 48) + x

⇒ 96 = 2x + 48

⇒ 2x = 96 − 48

⇒ 2x = 48

⇒ x = 24

The number of oranges is 24.

⇒ Number of mangoes = x + 48

⇒ Number of mangoes = 24 + 48 = 72

**∴ The correct answer is 72 mangoes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum and Difference Rule

If the sum (S) and difference (D) of two numbers are given, the larger number is found using the formula (S + D) ÷ 2 and the smaller number is (S − D) ÷ 2.

Linear Equations in One Variable

A linear equation is an equation where the highest power of the variable is exactly 1. It operates with a single variable and always yields a unique deterministic solution. Example: ax + b = c.

Proportional Division

When a total quantity is partitioned into two distinct segments A and B given an additive correlation (like A = B + k), expressing both segments in terms of a singular variable simplifies determining both values simultaneously.
</p

For a sphere, surface area ∝ (radius)².

When the radius increases by x%, the percentage increase in area is calculated using the successive percentage formula: x + x + (x × x)/100

questions.question: The ratio of 38 hours to 2 days is equivalent to what?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the ratio, ensure both quantities are in the same unit.

Convert 2 days to hours: 2 days = 2 × 24 = 48 hours.

The required ratio is 38 hours : 48 hours.

Dividing both numbers by their highest common factor (2) gives 19 : 24.

**∴ The correct answer is 19:24.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Quantity 1 = 38 hours

Quantity 2 = 2 days

 Equating Units to Find Ratio
 
 38 hours
 ÷ 2 → 19 parts
 
 2 days (48 hours)
 ÷ 2 → 24 parts
 Simplified Ratio = 19 : 24

**Calculations:**

⇒ 1 day = 24 hours

⇒ Quantity 2 in hours = 2 × 24 = 48 hours

⇒ Required Ratio = (Quantity 1) : (Quantity 2 in hours)

⇒ Required Ratio = 38 : 48

⇒ Simplifying the fraction by dividing by 2:

⇒ (38 ÷ 2) : (48 ÷ 2) = 19 : 24

**∴ The correct answer is 19:24.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Consistency in Ratios

A ratio is a relationship between two quantities of the same kind. Always convert units to match before calculating (e.g., convert days to hours).

Simplest Form

A ratio a:b is in its simplest form when 'a' and 'b' share no common factors other than 1. This is achieved by dividing both terms by their Highest Common Factor (HCF).

Compound Ratio

When two or more ratios are multiplied together, the result is known as a compound ratio. For a:b and c:d, the compound ratio is (a × c) : (b × d).
</p

questions.question: If the mean of 25, 29, 25, 32, 24 and x is 26, then the median of the data is:6544
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total sum of 6 observations = 26 × 6 = 156.

Value of missing term x = 156 − (25 + 29 + 25 + 32 + 24) = 21.

Data sorted in ascending order: 21, 24, 25, 25, 29, 32.

Median (for 6 terms) = Average of 3rd and 4th terms = (25 + 25) ÷ 2 = 25.

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data points: 25, 29, 25, 32, 24, x

Mean of the given data = 26

Total number of terms (n) = 6

**Formula Used:**

Mean = Sum of all terms ÷ Total number of terms

Median (for even n) = Average of the (n ÷ 2)th and (n ÷ 2 + 1)th terms in sorted data.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of the 5 known terms = 25 + 29 + 25 + 32 + 24 = 135

⇒ Mean = (135 + x) ÷ 6

⇒ 26 = (135 + x) ÷ 6

⇒ 156 = 135 + x

⇒ x = 156 − 135

⇒ x = 21

⇒ Arranging the data in ascending order: 21, 24, 25, 25, 29, 32

⇒ Since n = 6 (which is even), the median is the average of the 3rd and 4th terms.

⇒ 3rd term = 25

⇒ 4th term = 25

⇒ Median = (25 + 25) ÷ 2 = 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean

The mean is the mathematical average of a set of numbers, calculated by dividing the sum of all observations by the total count.

Median for Odd Data

When the number of observations (n) is odd, the median is exactly the middle value in the sorted list, which is the ((n + 1) ÷ 2)th term.

Mode

The mode is the value that appears most frequently in a given dataset. In this specific data, the mode is 25 as it appears twice.
</p

questions.question: If 896 bananas were distributed among three monkeys, respectively, in the ratio (4)/(6) : (2)/(2) : (2)/(2) , how many bananas did the third monkey get?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simplify ratio first: (4/6 : 2/2 : 2/2)

= (2/3 : 1 : 1)

Convert to whole numbers: multiply by 3 ⇒ (2 : 3 : 3)

Total parts = 8 ⇒ each part = 896 ÷ 8 = 112

**∴ Third monkey = 3 × 112 = 336**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total bananas = 896

Ratio = (4/6 : 2/2 : 2/2)

**Formula used:**

Share = (Individual ratio ÷ Sum of ratios) × Total

**Calculation:**

⇒ Simplify ratios: 4/6 = 2/3, 2/2 = 1

⇒ Ratio becomes: 2/3 : 1 : 1

⇒ Multiply all by 3 ⇒ 2 : 3 : 3

⇒ Total parts = 2 + 3 + 3 = 8

⇒ Value of 1 part = 896 ÷ 8 = 112

⇒ Third monkey share = 3 × 112 = 336

**∴ The correct answer is 336.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fractional Ratio

Convert fractional ratios into whole numbers by multiplying with LCM of denominators

Ratio Distribution

Individual share = (ratio part ÷ total parts) × total quantity

Shortcut Method

Always simplify ratio first before applying distribution

Common Mistake

Do not directly add fractions without converting to same base

questions.question: If the area of a square is 15.21 cm², then the perimeter (in cm) of the square is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of the square = √Area

⇒ Side = √15.21 = 3.9 cm

Perimeter = 4 × Side

⇒ Perimeter = 4 × 3.9 = 15.6 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 15.6 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of the square = 15.21 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Area of a square = a² (where a is the side length)

Perimeter of a square = 4 × a

**Calculations:**

⇒ a² = 15.21

⇒ a = √15.21

⇒ a = 3.9 cm

⇒ Perimeter of the square = 4 × a

⇒ Perimeter = 4 × 3.9

⇒ Perimeter = 15.6 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 15.6 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Diagonal of a Square

The diagonal (D) connects opposite corners and divides the square into two congruent right-angled triangles. Formula: D = a√2.

Area using Diagonal

If only the length of the diagonal is given, the area of the square can be directly calculated using the formula: Area = D² ÷ 2.

Circumcircle of a Square

The circumcircle touches all four vertices of the square. Its radius (R) is exactly half the length of the diagonal: R = a ÷ √2.

questions.question: If the number 2X73Y5 is divisible by 11, then find the value of (X−Y).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Rule of 11: (sum of odd places − sum of even places) = 0 or multiple of 11

Odd places: 2 + 7 + Y = 9 + Y

Even places: X + 3 + 5 = X + 8

Difference = (9 + Y) − (X + 8) = 1 + Y − X = 0

**∴ Answer = X − Y = 1**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 2X73Y5

**Formula used:**

For divisibility by 11: Difference of sum of digits at odd and even positions is 0 or multiple of 11

**Calculation:**

⇒ Odd position digits = 2, 7, Y

⇒ Sum = 2 + 7 + Y = 9 + Y

⇒ Even position digits = X, 3, 5

⇒ Sum = X + 3 + 5 = X + 8

⇒ Difference = (9 + Y) − (X + 8)

⇒ Difference = 1 + Y − X

⇒ For divisibility by 11 ⇒ 1 + Y − X = 0

⇒ X − Y = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between sum of digits in odd and even positions is 0 or a multiple of 11

Digit Positioning

Positions are counted from left to right starting from 1

Alternate Pattern

Digits are alternatively added and subtracted to check divisibility

General Form

(Sum of odd places − Sum of even places) = 0, ±11, ±22, ...

questions.question: Simplify: sqrt{sqrt{24² - 16² + 2²} + sqrt{2² times 3² + sqrt{169}}}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simplify inner values first

24² − 16² + 2² = 576 − 256 + 4 = 324 ⇒ √324 = 18

2²×3² + √169 = 4×9 + 13 = 36 + 13 = 49 ⇒ √49 = 7

Total = √(18 + 7) = √25

**∴ Answer = 5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

√( √(24² − 16² + 2²) + √(2² × 3² + √169) )

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS rule

**Calculation:**

⇒ √( √(576 − 256 + 4) + √(4 × 9 + √169) )

⇒ √( √(320 + 4) + √(36 + √169) )

⇒ √( √324 + √(36 + 13) )

⇒ √( 18 + √49 )

⇒ √( 18 + 7 )

⇒ √25

⇒ 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

Order: Brackets → Orders (powers, roots) → Division → Multiplication → Addition → Subtraction

Perfect Squares

Numbers like 324 and 49 are perfect squares: √324 = 18, √49 = 7

Nested Roots

Solve inner square roots first, then move outward step-by-step

Simplification Trick

Always try to convert expressions into perfect squares for quick evaluation

questions.question: Poonam sold a book to Mohini at a loss of 5% and Mohini sold it to Rupashi at a profit of 8%. If Rupashi bought the book for ₹1,539, then what was the cost price (in ₹) of the book for Poonam?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Poonam CP = 100

After 5% loss ⇒ 95

After 8% gain ⇒ 95 × 1.08 = 102.6

So, 102.6 corresponds to 1539

**∴ Answer = CP = 1539 × (100 ÷ 102.6) = ₹1500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Loss by Poonam = 5%

Profit by Mohini = 8%

Final selling price = 1539

**Formula used:**

Successive change: Final Price = CP × (1 − loss%) × (1 + profit%)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let CP of Poonam = x

⇒ Selling price to Mohini = x × (1 − 5/100) = 0.95x

⇒ Selling price to Rupashi = 0.95x × (1 + 8/100) = 0.95x × 1.08

⇒ Final price = 1.026x

⇒ 1.026x = 1539

⇒ x = 1539 ÷ 1.026

⇒ x = 1500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

Net effect = a × b ⇒ (1 − 5/100)(1 + 8/100)

Profit and Loss Formula

SP = CP × (1 ± percentage/100)

Chain Transactions

When multiple persons sell, apply successive multipliers step-by-step

Shortcut Base Method

Assume CP = 100 to quickly find equivalent final value

questions.question: A tank has three pipes: A, B and C. Pipe A fills the tank in 4 hours, Pipe B fills it in 6 hours and Pipe C empties it in 12 hours. If the three pipes are opened alternatively for 1 hour each (A first, then B, then C), how long will it take to fill the tank?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total capacity = LCM(4, 6, 12) = 12 units. Efficiency: A = +3, B = +2, C = −1.

Net work in 1 cycle (3 hours) = 3 + 2 − 1 = 4 units.

In 2 cycles (6 hours), the tank is filled up to 8 units. Remaining work = 12 − 8 = 4 units.

In the 7th hour, A fills 3 units. Remaining 1 unit is filled by B in 1/2 hour.

Total time = 6 + 1 + 1/2 = 7 (1)/(2) hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 7 (1)/(2) hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Pipe A to fill the tank = 4 hours

Time taken by Pipe B to fill the tank = 6 hours

Time taken by Pipe C to empty the tank = 12 hours

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time taken

 
 

 **Pipe**
 **Hours**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A
 4
 12
 3
 
 

 B
 6
 2
 
 

 C
 12
 −1
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ The pipes are opened alternatively for 1 hour each, completing 1 cycle in 3 hours.

⇒ Work done in 1 cycle (3 hours) = 3 (by A) + 2 (by B) − 1 (by C) = 4 units.

⇒ Work done in 2 complete cycles (6 hours) = 4 × 2 = 8 units.

⇒ Remaining work to be filled = 12 − 8 = 4 units.

⇒ In the 7th hour, Pipe A is opened. Work done by A in 1 hour = 3 units.

⇒ Work completed after 7 hours = 8 + 3 = 11 units.

⇒ Remaining work = 12 − 11 = 1 unit.

⇒ In the 8th hour, Pipe B is opened. Time taken by B to fill 1 unit = 1 ÷ 2 = 1/2 hour.

⇒ Total time required to fill the tank = 6 + 1 + 1/2 = 7 (1)/(2) hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 7 (1)/(2) hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Negative Efficiency

When a pipe empties a tank, its work is considered negative. Net work is obtained by subtracting the emptying rate from the filling rate.

Alternate Work Concept

When positive and negative work happen alternately, never divide the total work directly by the net cycle work. Always calculate up to (Total Work − Max Positive Work) first to avoid overestimating the time required.

Monkey and Greased Pole

This problem follows the same logic as a monkey climbing a pole (climbing up a certain distance and slipping down). The final jump always reaches the top, meaning the negative work part does not get a chance to act at the very end.

questions.question: If 4/7 of 2% of a number is 648, find the number.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

(4/7) of 2% of number = 648

2% = 2/100 ⇒ (4/7 × 2/100) = 8/700 = 4/350

So, (4/350) of number = 648

Number = 648 × (350/4)

**∴ Answer = 56700**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(4/7) of 2% of a number = 648

**Formula used:**

Percentage and fraction conversion

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the number be x

⇒ (4/7) × (2/100) × x = 648

⇒ (8/700) × x = 648

⇒ x = 648 × (700/8)

⇒ x = 648 × 87.5

⇒ x = 56700

**∴ The correct answer is 56700.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction

x% = x/100

Reverse Calculation

If fraction of a number is given, multiply by reciprocal to find original

Multiplication Rule

Successive fractions multiply directly: a/b × c/d

Shortcut Idea

Combine all fractions first, then solve in one step

questions.question: In triangle ABC , BD perp AC at D and angle DBC = 65^circ . E is a point on BC such that angle CAE = 30^circ . What is the measure of angle AEB ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In right ▵BDC, ∠C = 90° − ∠DBC = 90° − 65° = 25°.

In ▵AEC, E lies on BC, making ∠AEB the exterior angle at vertex E.

By the exterior angle theorem: ∠AEB = ∠CAE + ∠C.

∠AEB = 30° + 25° = 55°.

**∴ The correct answer is 55°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

BD ⊥ AC at D ⇒ ∠BDC = 90°

∠DBC = 65°

∠CAE = 30°

 
 

 
 
 
• 
 
•

**Formula Used:**

Angle sum of a triangle = 180°

Exterior angle = Sum of opposite interior angles

**Calculations:**

⇒ In ▵BDC, the sum of angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠BDC + ∠DBC + ∠C = 180°

⇒ 90° + 65° + ∠C = 180°

⇒ 155° + ∠C = 180°

⇒ ∠C = 180° − 155° = 25°

⇒ In ▵AEC, E lies on line segment BC.

⇒ ∠AEB is the exterior angle formed by extending CE to B.

⇒ Exterior ∠AEB = Interior ∠CAE + Interior ∠C

⇒ ∠AEB = 30° + 25° = 55°

**∴ The correct answer is 55°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Exterior Angle Theorem

The exterior angle of a triangle is exactly equal to the sum of its two remote (opposite) interior angles: ∠Ext = ∠A + ∠B.

Angle Sum Property of Triangle

The sum of all three interior angles in any triangle strictly evaluates to 180°: ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°.

Right-Angled Triangle Angles

In a right-angled triangle, one angle is exactly 90°, meaning the remaining two acute angles are complementary and always sum to 90°.
</p

questions.question: A mother is 25 years older than her daughter. In 15 years, the mother will be twice as old as the daughter. Find the daughter's current age.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Age difference always constant = 25

After 15 years: ratio Mother : Daughter = 2 : 1

Difference = 1 part = 25

Daughter after 15 years = 25

**∴ Answer = Present age = 25 − 15 = 10 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mother is 25 years older than daughter

After 15 years, mother is twice the daughter

**Formula used:**

Linear equation method

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let daughter's present age = x

⇒ Mother's present age = x + 25

⇒ After 15 years:

⇒ Daughter = x + 15

⇒ Mother = x + 25 + 15 = x + 40

⇒ Given: x + 40 = 2(x + 15)

⇒ x + 40 = 2x + 30

⇒ 40 − 30 = 2x − x

⇒ x = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Difference Rule

Difference between ages remains constant over time

Ratio Method

If one age is twice another, ratio = 2 : 1

Linear Equation

Translate word problems into equations and solve step-by-step

Future Age Concept

Add years to both ages when shifting to future scenarios

questions.question: A store is offering 'Buy 5, get 16 free' on household items. What is the net percentage discount (approximately) being offered by the store?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Buy 5, get 16 free ⇒ Total items = 21

Pay for only 5 items

Discount = Free items ÷ Total items = 16 ÷ 21

Percentage = (16/21) × 100 ≈ 76.19%

**∴ Answer = 76.19% (approx)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Buy 5 items, get 16 items free

**Formula used:**

Discount % = (Free items ÷ Total items) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total items received = 5 + 16 = 21

⇒ Cost is only for 5 items

⇒ Free items = 16

⇒ Discount % = (16 ÷ 21) × 100

⇒ = 76.19% (approx)

**∴ The correct answer is 76.19% (approx).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equivalent Discount Formula

Discount % = Free items ÷ (Buy + Free) × 100

Alternative View

Effective price per item = Cost of paid items ÷ Total items

Buy X Get Y Free

Convert into fraction: Y / (X + Y) to find discount

Shortcut Idea

Always include both bought and free items to compute percentage discount

questions.question: The average speed of a car running at 70 km/hr for 1 hour and ‘p’ km/hr for 1(1)/(2) hours is 58 km/hr. Find the value of p.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total time = 1 + 1.5 = 2.5 hours

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

58 = (70×1 + p×1.5) ÷ 2.5

Cross-multiply: 145 = 70 + 1.5p

**∴ Answer = p = 50**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed₁ = 70 km/hr, Time₁ = 1 hr

Speed₂ = p km/hr, Time₂ = 1.5 hr

Average speed = 58 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 70×1 + p×1.5

⇒ Total time = 1 + 1.5 = 2.5

⇒ 58 = (70 + 1.5p) ÷ 2.5

⇒ 58 × 2.5 = 70 + 1.5p

⇒ 145 = 70 + 1.5p

⇒ 145 − 70 = 1.5p

⇒ 75 = 1.5p

⇒ p = 75 ÷ 1.5 = 50

**∴ The correct answer is 50.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed Formula

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Distance Formula

Distance = Speed × Time

Weighted Average

When time differs, speeds are weighted by time

Shortcut Idea

Always multiply speed with respective time before averaging

questions.question: In an election, 70% of the total voters cast their votes. Out of these, 60% voted for candidate X and the remaining voted for candidate Y. If candidate Y received 8400 votes, calculate the total number of registered voters.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume total voters = 100

Votes cast = 70

Y gets 40% of 70 = 28

28 corresponds to 8400

**∴ Answer = Total voters = 8400 × (100 ÷ 28) = 30000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

70% voters cast votes

Out of them, 60% voted for X

So, 40% voted for Y

Votes received by Y = 8400

**Formula used:**

Percentage relation: Part = (Percentage ÷ 100) × Total

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let total voters = T

⇒ Votes cast = 70% of T = 0.7T

⇒ Votes for Y = 40% of 0.7T

⇒ = 0.4 × 0.7T = 0.28T

⇒ 0.28T = 8400

⇒ T = 8400 ÷ 0.28

⇒ T = 30000

**∴ The correct answer is 30000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage

When percentages are applied one after another, multiply them: 70% × 40%

Basic Percentage Formula

Value = (Percentage ÷ 100) × Total

Assumption Method

Assume total = 100 to simplify calculations quickly

Reverse Calculation

If part is known, divide by percentage to find total

questions.question: The amount on a sum of ₹1,800 at 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:

Effective Compound Interest Rate for 2 years at 10% = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10) ÷ 100 = 21%

Total Amount percentage = 100% (Principal) + 21% (Interest) = 121%

⇒ Total Amount = 1.21 × 1800 = 2178
